ask: when will this ethnicity group reach 25% of population
answer_headline: No official French ethnie/Muslim 25% year. INSEE does not project immigrés or descendants shares. Pew 2017 France Muslim 2050 scenarios top out at ~18% (high). Maghreb+Turquie/MO G1+G2 floor ~8% derived. Recomposition bounds only — no invented certainty year.

current_floors.notes: Fig.3 + texte. Ne pas appliquer à toute la population sans label logement ordinaire.

current_floors.label_fr: Maghreb + Turquie/Moyen-Orient — stock G1+G2 (borne basse géo)
current_floors.pct_note: DERIVED: 5 463 k / ~67,7 M (dénominateur implicite 7 174 k / 10,6 %). G2 mesuré en logement ordinaire — champ légèrement distinct. Ne pas présenter comme % officiel publié.

current_floors.notes: Pays de naissance de la mère uniquement. Exclut mères G2 nées en France d’origine maghrébine. Pas religion.

insee_immigres_or_descendants_share_scen.notes: Aucun scénario officiel INSEE ne publie une trajectoire de part immigrés ou immigrés+descendants. Impossible de dire si/quand ~25 % serait croisé — FAIL inventer.

ined_heran_pop_soc_558_immigres_by_origi.label: semi-official academic (INED Population & Sociétés) — immigrés G1 by origin, NOT ethnicity/Muslim
ined_heran_pop_soc_558_immigres_by_origi.author: François Héran
ined_heran_pop_soc_558_immigres_by_origi.notes: Hypothèse de persistance des facteurs migratoires + projections ONU. Immigrés seule génération. Maghreb/Afrique du Nord ~5,3 % en 2050 — loin de 25 %. Ne pas étiqueter INSEE.

pew_2017_europe_growing_muslim_populatio.label: NON-INSEE / NOT French official statistics
pew_2017_europe_growing_muslim_populatio.must_label: Scénario Pew (non officiel FR) — pas une statistique INSEE/INED
pew_2017_europe_growing_muslim_populatio.notes: Scénarios, pas prévisions. Aucun des trois n’atteint 25 % en France en 2050. High = 18 %.

assumption_band_25pct.purpose: Illustrate what would be needed to approach ~25% — DERIVED scenarios with listed assumptions. No certainty year as fact.

geo_maghreb_turquie_mo_stock.logic: Long-run stock share converges toward durable contribution share (births attributable to the geo group + net migration of that origin − exits). Current Maghreb+Turquie mother birth share alone ≈ 8.5% (2024 FR) — far below 25%. Even adding unobserved G2 mothers born in France, TeO2-style ancestry birth share is unpublished as an official series.

assumptions: Effective Maghreb+Turquie/MO-linked birth contribution stays ≈ 8–12% (mother-born Maghreb/Turquie 8.5% + partial G2 mothers — order-of-magnitude band)
Net migration of that origin remains a modest fraction of INSEE central solde (+150k total, all origins)
illustrative_scenarios.implication: Stock share rises slowly if at all toward a plateau well below 25%. No official crossing year. FAIL invent year.

assumptions: To converge near 25% of population, durable annual contribution (births + net migrants of Maghreb+Turquie/MO origin as share of all births+net entries) must approach ~25%
That is ≈ 3× current Maghreb+Turquie mother birth share (8.5%)
Would require sustained Maghreb+Turquie/MO-linked births and/or net migration far above observed levels
illustrative_scenarios.implication: Bound only: 25% is not reachable under continuation of current birth-origin structure. No year assigned.

assumptions: Use Pew 2017 France scenarios as upper published envelope (non-INSEE)
illustrative_scenarios.implication: Even Pew high stays 7 pts under 25% at 2050. No Pew scenario hits 25%.

assumptions: Assume continued net gain of ~0.25 pts/year (rough order of Pew medium path 8.8→17.4 over ~34 years ≈ 0.25 pts/yr)
Then +7 pts would take on the order of ~28 years after 2050 → mid-2070s ballpark
illustrative_scenarios.implication: Order-of-magnitude band under heroic continuation of Pew-medium pace AFTER already assuming Pew-high 2050. NOT an official year. NOT INSEE. Soft-hold: never ship as fact.

assumptions: Long-run Muslim declare share cannot sustainably exceed the share of births that grow up Muslim (transmission ~91% TeO2 among those raised Muslim — 6793308) plus net Muslim migration
Mother Maghreb+Turquie birth share ≈ 8.5% is a lower proxy for 'countries of Muslim tradition' births — incomplete (excludes Sahel, G2 mothers, conversions, etc.)
TeO2 shows high transmission but also some exit; Pew models switching
illustrative_scenarios.implication: Without a durable birth+migration contribution near 25%, stock share does not lock at 25%. Bound, not a date.

immigres_alone_or_immigres_plus_descenda.naive_sum_note: DERIVED 11.2% + 12.0% — different champs (pop vs logement ordinaire). INSEE does not publish this sum as official all-population %. Near 25% arithmetically for ALL origins combined, not Maghreb/Muslim.

crosses_25pct_summary.muslim_official_fr: FAIL — no projection series; TeO2 stock 10% (18–59) only
crosses_25pct_summary.maghreb_turquie_mo_g1_g2_floor: No — ~8% derived current; no official path to 25%
